A lush retreat emerging from the Ardennes
Château de Vignée is a harbour in the wild for those returning after the chase. Sourced by the Ardennes’ fluid state of beauty. Designed to treasure whoever resides in it.
Explore Rooms
ARDEN is a terroir driven restaurant working with what nature has to grant. Chef Marius Bosmans grows and gathers vegetables from the chateau greenhouse to create a pure, yet expressive cuisine in rhythm of the seasons. A curated selection of wines and local craft beers accompanies Marius servings.
Savour more
A sanctuary for body and being
Sprung from the river Lesse. Soothing floods from within. The spa nurtures ego as well as physique with an array of rituals and facilities including a swimming pool, hammam and Finnish sauna overlooking the riverbank.

About - Chateau De Vignée
there are no lines in nature
— only areas of colour
HISTORY
Château de Vignée is a landmark amidst the strong-willed landscape of the Ardennes.
Sprouting from a 400-year-old hunting narrative and acting as a field hospital in the Second World War, the 17th-century castle has always been a stronghold in the Famenne region.
HERE AND NOW
Over the years, Château de Vignée has gained deeper insight into the needs of its guests only to arise anew as a lavish boutique estate. The opulent suites are tailored to unwind, restaurant ARDEN caters to any gastronomical urges while the spa site tends to physical and spiritual solace. The tailored event spaces add to the flourishing spirit of the chateau site.
ANCIENT ROOTS
Drawing from its ancient roots, the chateau is raised from regional marbles and the ruins of the previous building. The interior takes cues from the overwhelming force and beauty of the native scenery surrounding the estate. Aware of its ever-evolving setting, Château de Vignée has aligned with the seasons both aesthetically and gastronomically offering a genuine Ardennes experience.
Sustainability Policy
At Château de Vignée, sustainability is at the heart of our approach, as we believe that high-quality hospitality must respect its environment. Located in a preserved natural setting, our establishment is committed to responsibly managing resources, reducing its environmental impact, and promoting local and seasonal products. We also involve our staff and encourage our guests to adopt responsible practices. This approach is part of a continuous improvement process, including recognized commitments such as Green Key certification.
